**Department:** Human Resources

**Location:** Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Senior HR Recruiter** to manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities for technical, non\-technical, and managerial positions. The candidate should have strong sourcing skills, excellent communication, candidate\-handling ability, and experience in bulk/manufacturing recruitment.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** from manpower requisition to joining.
* Understand manpower requirements and prepare effective recruitment strategies.
* Source candidates through **Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, consultants, walk\-ins, and campus recruitment**.
* Handle recruitment for **Production, Maintenance, Quality, CNC/VMC, Engineering, Safety, HR, and other manufacturing positions**.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Coordinate technical interviews with respective department heads.
* Manage candidate follow\-up, salary negotiation, selection, offer release, and joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and daily/weekly recruitment reports.
* Handle **bulk recruitment and shop\-floor manpower requirements**.
* Coordinate with manpower consultants and recruitment agencies.
* Conduct **campus drives, job fairs, walk\-in drives, and recruitment campaigns**.
* Maintain a strong candidate pipeline for critical and recurring positions.
* Monitor recruitment **TAT, joining ratio, offer\-to\-joining ratio, and source effectiveness**.
* Coordinate pre\-employment documentation and background verification.
* Support onboarding and ensure smooth joining of selected candidates.
* Prepare and present recruitment MIS reports to management.
* Ensure recruitment activities comply with company policies and applicable labour requirements.

Key Skills Required

* End\-to\-end recruitment
* Manufacturing / Engineering recruitment
* Bulk hiring
* Technical recruitment
* Naukri / Indeed / LinkedIn sourcing
* Interview coordination
* Salary negotiation
* Consultant management
* Campus recruitment
* Recruitment MIS \& Excel
* Candidate relationship management
* Strong communication and negotiation skills

Qualification

* **MBA / PGDM / MSW / MA HR / Any relevant HR qualification**
* Strong knowledge of recruitment processes and HR practices.

Preferred Experience

* 5–8 years of relevant recruitment experience.
* Candidates with **manufacturing industry recruitment experience** will be preferred.
* Experience in hiring **Production, CNC/VMC, Maintenance, Quality, Engineering, and shop\-floor manpower** will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Position closure within defined TAT
* Quality of hire
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio
* Recruitment cost optimization
* Candidate retention
* Source effectiveness
* Monthly manpower closure target

Personal Attributes

* Proactive and target\-oriented
* Good interpersonal skills
* Strong follow\-up capability
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies simultaneously
* Good stakeholder management
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team

title: US IT Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced **US IT Recruiter** to join our recruitment team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and recruiting qualified IT professionals for clients across the United States. The recruiter should have strong knowledge of US staffing processes, IT technologies, tax terms, and employment types.

Key Responsibilities

* Source and recruit IT professionals through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, internal databases, and referrals.
* Review resumes and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
* Conduct initial screening interviews to evaluate technical skills, experience, communication, and cultural fit.
* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, from sourcing to onboarding.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Negotiate compensation rates and finalize offers.
* Maintain candidate records and recruitment reports in ATS/CRM systems.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future requirements.
* Understand and work with various employment types such as W2, C2C, and 1099\.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements and recruitment policies.
* Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* 1\-5\+ years of experience in US IT Recruitment.
* Hands\-on experience with Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other sourcing platforms.
* Strong understanding of IT technologies and technical skill sets.
* Knowledge of US visa classifications such as H1B, GC, USC, OPT, CPT, and EAD.
* Familiarity with tax terms including W2, C2C, and 1099\.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with direct clients, implementation partners, or MSP/VMS requirements.
* Proven track record of successful placements in the US market.
* Experience using ATS tools and recruitment CRM platforms.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
**Overview:**

The Talent Acquisition Manager will play a key role in enabling business growth by attracting and bringing in the right talent to support current and future business needs. Reporting to the Head of TAA, the role will be expected to work closely with business and HR stakeholders to understand evolving talent requirements and translate these into effective sourcing and hiring strategies.


The Talent Acquisition Manager will provide market insights, sourcing expertise and strategic hiring support to deliver high\-quality hiring outcomes across multiple functions and geographies. The role will also be expected to enhance the candidate experience, support diversity hiring ambitions and contribute to employer branding initiatives that strengthen Maersk’s ability to attract and engage the right talent.


**What You Can Expect:**

* Deliver timely and high\-quality hiring outcomes through effective sourcing and talent attraction strategies.
* Partner closely with business leaders and HR stakeholders to understand hiring requirements, workforce capabilities, and talent gaps.
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment activities, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for both candidates and hiring managers.
* Build and nurture talent pipelines through relevant hiring communities, professional networks, industry forums, and events.
* Leverage market insights and talent intelligence to advise stakeholders on talent availability, competitor landscapes, and hiring trends.
* Support and advocate diversity hiring initiatives to help achieve Maersk's diversity and inclusion ambitions.
* Contribute to employer branding and talent attraction initiatives that enhance Maersk's visibility and reputation as an employer of choice.
* Utilize innovative sourcing approaches and candidate engagement strategies to identify and attract top talent.
* Support continuous improvement of recruitment processes and hiring practices to drive efficiency and effectiveness.

**Critical Competencies:**

* 10\-12\+ years of recruitment and talent acquisition experience.
* Proven expertise in sourcing, talent attraction, and candidate engagement strategies.
* Experience driving employer branding and digital talent attraction campaigns.
* Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
* Talent market intelligence and workforce planning awareness.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Results orientation, attention to detail, and strong problem\-solving skills

**Internal Stakeholders**

* Business Leaders
* HR Business Partners

* Talent Acquisition \& Attraction Teams
* Employees and Hiring Managers

**External Stakeholders**

* Recruitment Partners and Vendors

As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in maintaining our clients' IT infrastructure and systems. Your expertise will help keep everything running smoothly by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll be the go\-to person to restore services and ensure our clients' satisfaction.  

  

Your typical day involves managing work queues, addressing incidents and requests within agreed SLAs, and updating tickets with the actions taken. By identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate, you'll be instrumental in maintaining service quality. You'll also collaborate closely with other teams and clients to provide second\-level support, ensuring seamless communication and efficient problem resolution.  

  

You will execute changes meticulously, understanding and mitigating risks, and contribute to the change management process with detailed documentation. Your role includes auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and identifying tasks for automation to enhance efficiency. Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.  

  

Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high\-pressure situations.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Moderate\-level experience in managed services roles handling cross\-technology infrastructure.
